content: Aaradhya Verma called insurance agent Neha Kapoor to discuss her expired health insurance policy and the 15% premium increase. Neha explained that the increase was due to rising medical costs and inflation, and reminded Aaradhya of an alternative plan with a lower premium and higher deductible. Aaradhya decided to proceed with the alternative plan and asked for assistance with the renewal process.

action_items: Assist customer with the renewal process for the alternative plan
